mee_2021.title: 生态环境部、国家统计局关于发布2021年电力二氧化碳排放因子的公告 (公告2024年第12号), 附件1 表3 + 附件2 计算说明
mee_2021.note: First edition of this series (no earlier year exists with this method). National 0.5568. Method: 30 provincial grids, Tibet/HK/Macau/Taiwan excluded; fossil fuel use & generation from China Energy Statistical Yearbook; inter-provincial/inter-regional exchange from CEC China Electric Power Yearbook; import-country factors from IEA Emissions Factors.

nbs_2024_generation.title: NBS 2024 Jan-Dec cumulative above-scale (规模以上工业) power generation by province: total (发电量) and thermal (火力发电量); compiled as labelled bar charts by 北极星电力网 (BJX), republished by 广东省水力和新能源发电工程学会
nbs_2024_generation.note: NBS's own provincial database (data.stats.gov.cn) returns HTTP 403 from this network, so values were transcribed from BJX charts that cite NBS. Cross-checked against the BJX text article https://www.gdshe.org/article/23674.html (thermal and total match for Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Shandong, Hebei, Jiangsu, Gansu, Ningxia, Hubei, Hunan, Guangxi, Jilin, Hainan, Tibet). Sum of 31 provinces: thermal 63438.1, total 94181.0 (100 GWh); the total equals NBS's published 2024 national above-scale generation (94,181), confirming transcription.

caveats: ci basis: MEE/NBS factors are DIRECT CO2 from fossil combustion (no lifecycle/upstream, no CH4/N2O) and CONSUMPTION-based: each province's factor = (own generation emissions + emissions embodied in net imports from other provinces, its regional grid and other countries) / (own generation + net imports) (method eq. 7). Clean-power exporters (Sichuan, Yunnan, Qinghai) get low values; importers (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Chongqing) inherit their suppliers' mix. Covers all generation incl. non-fossil. Not directly comparable to a generation-based factor or to fos.

Tibet (Xizang) is excluded from the MEE provincial and regional series in every edition (methodology: 暂不考虑西藏自治区); ci and dec are null. Any value used in the app (e.g. the Southwest regional grid 2023 = 247.2 gCO2/kWh, or a hydro-based estimate) must be flagged as a proxy - none is supplied here.

dec spans only 2021->2023 (3-point series; the MEE provincial series starts with 2021). Year-to-year changes are dominated by hydro conditions (2022 Sichuan/Yunnan drought, weak 2023 hydro) and trade flows, so dec is noisy and negative (ci rising) for several hydro-linked provinces. It is not a robust long-term trend. National factor 0.5568 -> 0.5306 = 2.38%/yr decline.

fos uses NBS ABOVE-SCALE (规模以上, revenue >= CNY 20m) generation, which omits most distributed rooftop solar and small plants, so fossil share is OVERSTATED where distributed PV is large (e.g. Shandong, Hebei, Henan, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui). Above-scale total for 2024 is ~94,181 vs full-caliber 100,869 (x100 GWh). Example: Qinghai energy bureau reports total 1149.2 / thermal 130.4 (11.3%) vs NBS above-scale 1035.2 / 133.2 (12.9%); Henan reports 1158 renewable vs 588.6 above-scale.
NBS 火力发电 (thermal) includes biomass and waste-to-energy, so fos slightly overstates the strictly-fossil share (biomass ~2% of national generation).

fos is production-based (in-province generation); ci is consumption-based. For big exporters (Inner Mongolia, Shanxi, Xinjiang, Ningxia, Sichuan, Yunnan) and importers (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong) the two bases diverge materially.
Year mismatch: ci is 2023 (latest MEE edition), fos is 2024 (latest NBS provincial data found).
fos values transcribed from labelled chart images; transcription risk low (values printed on bars, spot-checked against a text article) but not zero.
